headerDisplay: Plays HEOS Music and Spotify Connect on the surround speakers only, by switching the receiver to Speaker Preset 2 while that input is active. Set up Preset 2 on the receiver first (see the README).

inputs.title: Inputs that use the rear speakers
inputs.description: Receiver input codes. NET is HEOS Music, which Spotify Connect and AirPlay use.

soundMode.title: Sound mode while on the rear speakers
soundMode.description: Multi Ch Stereo sends stereo to every active speaker. Leave empty to keep whatever mode the receiver picks.
